index.title: Webhooks
index.subtitle: Signed store events delivered to your systems — endpoints, delivery history and test events

help_texts.endpoint_help: Baxela POSTs a signed JSON payload to this URL for each subscribed event.
help_texts.url_help: Must be HTTPS in production; internal addresses are rejected for safety.
help_texts.secret_once: Copy this signing secret now — it is shown exactly once and never again. Configure your receiver to verify the X-Signature header with it.
help_texts.secret_verify: Deliveries are signed with HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body.
help_texts.deliveries_help: The most recent deliveries for this endpoint — response status, attempts and sanitized response snippets.
help_texts.no_deliveries: No deliveries yet — send a test event to verify the receiver.
help_texts.archive_help: Archiving stops deliveries permanently. The delivery history is preserved for auditing. This cannot be undone.

messages.test_sent: Test event dispatched — check the delivery log
